ayahOccurrences.text: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine plural passive imperfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يُدَعُّونَ is in the derivative form: يَدُعُّ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
د/ع/ع   d–ʿ–ʿ to push violently, to shove, to drive away
; barren stony land; to fill up, to walk with a limp.

Of this root, 3 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
يَدُعُّ yaduʿʿ; يُدَعُّونَ yudaʿʿūn and دَعٌّ daʿʿ.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَدُعُّ yaduʿʿ [imperf. of v. دَعَّ daʿʿa, trans.; pas. V. يُدَعُّ yudaʿʿ] to push violently, to shove

(107:2) فَذَلِكَ الَّذِي يَدُعُّ الْيَتِيمَ it is he who pushes aside the orphan.

entries.label: دَعّ
entries.definitionHtml:
دَعّ daʿʿ [v. n. used adverbially for emphasis] pushing or thrusting, shoving in

(52:13) يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا on that Day they will be thrust into the Fire of Hell violently.
